dimensions.assessment: The plan defines bounded qualification gates: installer verification, foundation verification, seven worker compilations, candidate CI, eleven-dimension independent audit, merge/default-branch CI and a fresh native #99 qualification. It explicitly does not treat the failed run as qualification.
The proposed adoption, required pins and App preflight guard, verification/activation sequence, superseded draft handling, rollback and out-of-scope work are covered at planning depth.

The plan requires installer and foundation checks, all seven worker compilations, actual candidate CI, source post-merge checks and later default-branch CI. These are future gates, not claimed as completed adoption evidence.
It preserves the exact checked/published-tree equality guard and requires independent audit before merge; the failed candidate's negative receipts remain explicit.

Opaque link path/mode/blob metadata is preserved without materializing links or reading targets, bound into command evidence, and reconstructed from the admitted commit. Existing security and protected-publication boundaries remain in force.

The plan adopts the exact merged source through the official immutable-source installer, maintains the publisher equality invariant, regenerates installed pins and updates the existing App preflight pin and exact-pin guard.
It calls for updating tooling and runbooks with the failure, draft PR and qualification limits, and retains explicit rollback and activation instructions.

The plan keeps public CLI/SDLC at 0.12.55/0.21.6 and the source manifest at 0.21.11, while preserving the 6,600-second window, 125-minute job, one correction, exact #99 grant, models, resources, environment, trusted inputs, checks, identity and accepted product model.

The supplied context records source merge 59ded863109b045e399931dbad61e6cfdb698107, accepted seven-dimension technical audit d979e584 and passing source repository/package CI. The plan correctly requires post-merge source checks and later adopter/native receipts rather than representing them as already complete.
Independent planning acceptance is a precondition to installer/configuration changes; independent candidate review and an audit covering all eleven Done dimensions are required at their later gates.

The plan distinguishes the failed native run and its draft from qualification, requires superseded-draft reconciliation before one fresh #99 request, prohibits manual model calls during that serialized qualification, and leaves registry publication and public issue-control SDK adoption separate. It does not infer product, production or protected-publication authority from delegated technical work.
